title: Language policies for signage

location.series: City of Helsinki live visual identity guidelines

slide_intent: Make language presence deliberate so residents can recognize their place in public communications.
strategic_value: Consistent bilingual identification can make Helsinki’s shared civic role visible at entrances.
demonstration: This expanded webpage-section capture pairs language-policy guidance with a photograph of multilingual information on a building entrance.
practical_value: Select logo languages for the operator and visitors while ensuring Swedish presence in bilingual or multilingual resident communications.

content_islands.name: Language policy
content_islands.spec: Keep audience choice with the equal-standing requirement.

content_islands.name: Entrance application
content_islands.spec: Place the photographed door and facade information below the policy.

ingredient.name: Public-space logo language
ingredient.application: Use the bilingual framed logo or equal-height Helsinki and Helsingfors logos sufficiently far apart.
ingredient.scope: Public spaces; preserve Swedish-logo presence in bilingual and multilingual resident communications.

reference_purposes.Intent: The text states that Finnish and Swedish have equal standing in public areas.
reference_purposes.Constraint: Public-space use requires the bilingual logo or equal-height Helsinki and Helsingfors logos placed sufficiently apart.
reference_purposes.Application: It connects logo-language selection to the operator and visitor target group.
